title: Planted q-ary Dual-Intersection Cascade Bridge: Exact Candidate Subspace Size Law, Spurious Survivor Decay, and Oversampling Recovery Probability

theorems.name: Deterministic Rank-Cardinality Law and Recovery Criterion
theorems.statement: For any m-tuple U_perp = (u^(1), ..., u^(m)) in (B^perp)^m of rank r_perp = dim(span(U_perp)), the orthogonal intersection subspace B_hat_m(U_perp) contains B, has cardinality q^(n - r_perp), and equals B if and only if r_perp = n - d.

theorems.name: Exact Exponential Decay of Expected Spurious Survivors
theorems.statement: Under m i.i.d. uniform dual samples U_perp ~ Unif((B^perp)^m), every non-planted vector x in F_q^n \ B survives in B_hat_m(U_perp) with probability q^(-m), so E[|B_hat_m(U_perp)|] = q^d + (q^n - q^d) q^(-m) and E[|B_hat_m(U_perp) \ B|] = (q^n - q^d) q^(-m).

theorems.name: Exact Full-Recovery Probability Law and Two-Sided Oversampling Bounds
theorems.statement: For m >= n - d with oversampling margin Delta_m = m - (n - d) >= 0, P_recover(q, n - d, m) = Pr[B_hat_m(U_perp) = B] = prod_(i=1)^(n-d) (1 - q^(-(Delta_m + i))), satisfying 1 - sum_(i=1)^(n-d) q^(-(Delta_m + i)) <= P_recover <= 1 - q^(-(Delta_m + 1)).
